### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>actions/download-artifact (actions/download-artifact)</summary>

### [`v8.0.2`](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/releases/tag/v8.0.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/compare/v8.0.1...v8.0.2)

##### What's Changed

- Update the readme by [@​danwkennedy](https://redirect.github.com/danwkennedy) in [#​473](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/pull/473)
- Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.
- Update [@​actions/artifact](https://redirect.github.com/actions/artifact) to 6.3.1 by [@​tunc-d](https://redirect.github.com/tunc-d) in [#​492](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/pull/492)
- Prepare download-artifact v8.0.2 by [@​tunc-d](https://redirect.github.com/tunc-d) in [#​493](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/pull/493)

##### New Contributors

- [@​tunc-d](https://redirect.github.com/tunc-d) made their first contribution in [#​492](https://redirect.github.com/actions/download-artifact/pull/492)
